summary: Frontend-only verification of the login wordmark fit fix. Verified at viewports 390x844, 360x780, and 430x932 that the testID='app-logo' bounding box starts at x=24 (left pad spacing.lg) and has width ≈ (viewport-48)*0.85 with zero horizontal overflow (body.scrollWidth equals viewport width). Both AFTER and PARTY render on single lines in stacked layout, pink dot visible after PARTY. Login with test@afterparty.app / Test1234! succeeded and the party feed shows 'London'. No console errors observed; only benign react-native-web deprecation warnings for 'textShadow*' and 'shadow*' style props.
action_items: Optional (non-blocking): react-native-web prints deprecation warnings for 'textShadow*' and 'shadow*' style props used in Wordmark glow and other elements. Consider migrating to the new 'textShadow' / 'boxShadow' shorthand to silence console noise on web.
critical_code_review_comments: Wordmark fit math is correct and matches observed boxes (fillWidth ≈ (width-48)*0.85, font ≈ fillWidth/3.4). AFTER/PARTY are rendered as separate <Text> rows (stacked), so adjustsFontSizeToFit on native will fit each word independently — which is what you want for narrow devices.
On web the 'fit' props (numberOfLines/adjustsFontSizeToFit) are intentionally not applied; current widths comfortably fit within the computed fillWidth at tested viewports, so no clipping observed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login wordmark fit verified via Playwright at 360/390/430 viewports: left=24, width=(viewport-48)*0.85, no body overflow; both AFTER and PARTY on single lines; dot visible. Login to feed works. Only non-blocking RN-web deprecation warnings in console.
